name: Reverse Box Turn (backward half)
notes: Owner's description: the Box Turn with everything reversed; follows Reverse Box Turn (forward half). Back on the lead's right, side, close, turning a quarter to the left; no rise. Called the Left Box Turn in the American syllabus. Turn timing from the book, as in the Box Turn. The book's "body turns less" for the lead isn't drawn: pointing his count-2 foot further round lands its toes on the other foot. Reviewed by the owner (2026-11-19).
